dedupe_keys.name: gtfs2gmns convert gtfs feeds into gmns multimodal transit networks

description: GTFS2GMNS is an open-source Python package that builds multimodal transit networks from General Transit Feed Specification feeds in the General Modeling Network Specification (GMNS) format. Its PyPI description says the converted physical and service networks suit modelling tasks such as transit routing, traffic flow assignment, simulation and service network optimisation. Users need stops, routes, trips, stop times and agency files and can combine several agencies; the test folder uses feeds from Cottonwood Area Transit, Flagstaff Mountain Line and Sedona RoadRunner in Arizona. PyPI gives version 0.8.0 and an MIT licence, with alpha status. Coverage: any GTFS feed. Format and access: Python package on PyPI. Licence and cost: MIT, free. Caveats: alpha software, and the user guide is a shared document open for comments. It supports network flow and optimisation models that read GMNS. It relates to GMNS, the GTFS specification and the Dyno-Demand standard in the catalogue.
